title: Reset your password
text: If you forgot your password, choose Sign in, then Forgot password. We email a reset link that works for one hour. Open it and pick a new password of at least twelve characters.

title: Change your email address
text: Open Settings, then Account, and edit the email field. We send a confirmation message to the new address; the change takes effect once you click the link inside it.

title: Turn on two-step sign-in
text: Two-step sign-in asks for a code from an authenticator app after your password. Enable it under Settings, Security. Keep the printed recovery codes somewhere safe.

title: Lost your phone with the authenticator
text: Without your authenticator you can still sign in with one of your recovery codes. After signing in, remove the old device and set up two-step sign-in again on the new phone.

title: Export notes as PDF
text: Select one or more notes, open the Share menu and choose Export as PDF. Images and tables are kept; attachments are listed by name at the end of the file.

title: Back up everything
text: Settings, Data, Download archive creates a zip of every note, notebook and attachment. Large accounts can take a few minutes; we email you when the archive is ready.

title: Restore a deleted note
text: Deleted notes stay in the Trash for thirty days. Open Trash, select the note and choose Restore. After thirty days a note is removed for good and cannot be recovered.

title: Share a notebook with your team
text: Open the notebook, choose Share and enter your teammates' addresses. Each person can be a viewer or an editor, and you can change or remove access at any time.

title: Stop sharing a note
text: Open the note's Share panel to see everyone with access. Remove a person to revoke their access immediately, or turn off the public link so it stops working.

title: Work offline
text: Notes you have opened recently are saved on your device, so you can read and edit them without a connection. Changes upload automatically when you are back online.

title: Fix sync conflicts
text: If the same note was edited on two devices while offline, we keep both versions. The note shows a conflict banner; compare the two and keep the one you want.

title: Sync is stuck
text: If changes are not appearing on your other devices, check that you are signed in to the same account on each, then pull down on the note list to refresh.

title: Search inside notes
text: The search bar finds words in titles, note text and the text of attached PDFs. Put a phrase in quotes to match it exactly, or add tag: to search one tag.

title: Organise with tags
text: Add tags from the note's toolbar. A note can have many tags, and tags can be nested with a slash, such as work/projects. Click a tag in the sidebar to filter.

title: Use templates
text: Templates start a note with a ready structure, such as meeting notes or a weekly plan. Choose New from template, or save any note as a template from its menu.

title: Set a reminder
text: Open a note, choose the bell icon and pick a date and time. You get a notification on every signed-in device, and the note appears in the Reminders list.

title: Upgrade your plan
text: Compare plans under Settings, Billing. Upgrading takes effect immediately; you pay the difference for the rest of the current billing period.

title: Cancel your subscription
text: Cancel any time under Settings, Billing, Cancel plan. You keep paid features until the end of the period you already paid for, then the account becomes free.

title: Request a refund
text: Refunds are available within fourteen days of a payment. Contact support from the Help menu with the date of the charge and we will return it to the original card.

title: Update your payment card
text: Replace an expired or lost card under Settings, Billing, Payment method. The new card is used for your next renewal; past invoices are unchanged.

title: Download invoices
text: Every invoice is listed under Settings, Billing, Invoices. Each one can be downloaded as a PDF with your company name and tax number if you added them.

title: Delete your account
text: Deleting your account removes every note and attachment permanently after a seven-day grace period. Download an archive first if you want to keep anything.

title: Keyboard shortcuts
text: Press the question mark key anywhere to see all shortcuts. Common ones: new note, search, bold and italic text, and moving between notes with the arrow keys.

title: Dark mode
text: Switch between light and dark themes under Settings, Appearance, or follow your system setting so the app changes automatically at night.
